data.acceptance: A tracked canonical source for the flow-watchdog behavior exists outside .hive-flow/data, with a documented install/generation path for the live runtime copy. runOnce invokes the dead-PID/no-result liveness classifier and takes the intended recovery or routing action exactly once. Long-horizon busy-not-progressing and BLOCKED_TRUE_HUMAN_GATE nag paths are either corrected or explicitly documented as by-design in tests. Privacy/private-path guard passes before any tracked source is committed. Tests cover the classifier-called path, no spam loop, and normal COMPLETE_NO_ACTION quiet behavior.
